findings.name: Restock can take an existing active listing offline
findings.expected: An inventory-only adjustment preserves listing availability or explicitly explains an unpublish
findings.reproduction: Restock an existing Active synthetic listing missing a currently required 3D model, and check from a buyer session.
findings.observed: Product 19 went from 987 to 988 stock on Restock and from Active to Draft because it had no required 3D model. Buyers received HTTP 404. A synthetic model upload and normal admin approval restored Active. Manual Deduct restored stock to 987.

findings.name: Supabase WebSocket disabled on production seller Orders
findings.expected: Configured Supabase WebSocket transport can initialize
findings.reproduction: Open production Orders as the synthetic seller and inspect browser console and WebSocket requests.
findings.observed: Browser console reported a publishable or non-JWT key detected and disabled Supabase WebSocket. Observed sockets were Pusher. Blocking the observed socket host and Supabase hosts still resulted in a 200 Inertia orders poll returning Cancelled within 7.128 seconds.
